verdict.rationale: Tilled is a payments platform that handles merchant and cardholder data, so controlling data retention and deletion is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers API keys, onboarding, pricing, payouts, disputes, webhooks and white-labeling, but nothing on retention policies, deletion APIs or data-erasure controls. Voiding or refunding transactions is not data deletion, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
